REF (B) TURKISH NOTAMS A4401/26 AND A4388/26 (011308 AND 010914
EUECYIYN OCT 2026).
REF (C) GREEK NOTAM A3595/26 (300733 EUECYIYN SEP 2026).
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAMS
A4401/26 AND A4388/26 (011308 AND 010914 EUECYIYN OCT 2026)
ARE NULL AND VOID SINCE THEY REFER TO MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN
ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS
IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE INTERNATIONAL RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE
HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH THE HELLENIC ATS
AND AIS UNITS.
FURTHERMORE THE HELLENIC POSITIONS HAVE ALREADY BEEN EXPRESSED IN
THE REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A3621/26 (011156 EUECYIYN OCT 2026), THEY 
REMAIN UNCHANGED AND THEY ARE THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE WITHIN ATH
INAI FIR AS WELL AS THE REF (C) GREEK NOTAM A3595/26, WHICH IS FULLY 
IN FORCE.
